tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one ground. Every panel, header and status bar fills with it; sediment has no raised cards.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Wells inside surface: buttons, text fields, selects, the selected tile. A recess, not a card.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Addition. The icon's own ground; the white of a tape label. Use for at most one label-like object per view, never as a page background.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Addition. Beige J-card accent behind TapeLabel and the cover only. ink reads 11.7:1 on it (light) and 8.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline separators and resting control borders, 1px. Decorative at 1.5:1 (light) / 1.8:1 (dark) on surface, below 3:1 as in the source; a control is also told apart by its field fill, and hover raises its border to ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and marks on surface, field, paper and tape; hovered control borders; the focus ring. 14.0:1 on surface (light), 15.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Utility labels, metadata lines, sizes, hints and the resting status dot, on surface or field. 5.9:1 on surface (light), 8.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one orange. Primary-action fill, text selection, busy and error marks. Same value in both themes. Never text on light surface (2.5:1); on dark surface it reads 5.4:1.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks on signal, in both themes (CONTROL_INK). 5.5:1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The empty-state line, once per window.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The open archive's file name; truncates, never wraps.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase name beside a 23px StrataMark in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop an archive here, or gather files into a ZIP.

styles.name: utility
styles.usage: Set in capitals: section labels, format lists, the appearance select. Sizes and status lines keep their own case.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Before a separator under the archive header.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Display line to its hint.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Button padding, vertical.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The gap between any two items in a row or stack.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Status bar padding, vertical.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Button padding, horizontal.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel inset on every edge; the window's only margin.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, selects, tape labels.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Dialogs and windows; cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile (192 on an 864 square).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Every button, field and select.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: One entry row in the contents list.

tokens.name: mark-header
tokens.usage: StrataMark beside the wordmark.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: The status dot's diameter, centred in a 7px cell.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Every border and separator.
